description.value: Observatory Wines is a boutique estate winery perched 400 metres above Okanagan Lake near Summerland, with panoramic views stretching north to Peachland and south toward Naramata. Winemaker and owner Blair Gillingham specializes in Grüner Veltliner, shaped by years working in Austria, alongside small-production estate wines from the east-facing lakefront vineyard. Drop-in tastings are welcome for small groups, making it a natural scenic stop along the southern Okanagan cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Summerland Estate Winery' but the website at observatorywines.ca confirms a rebrand to 'Observatory Wines' effective May 1st (ca. 2024), so the website name is used per Rule 12 and the discrepancy is flagged. The website provides a confirmed phone (250-328-3486) and full address (21606 Bridgeman Road, Summerland, BC V0H 1Z6), and confirms the business is actively operating as a wine tasting room and shop. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all remain null.
concerns: OSM name 'Summerland Estate Winery' is outdated — business rebranded to 'Observatory Wines' as of May 1st ca. 2024; OSM record should be updated.
OSM has no phone number; phone 250-328-3486 sourced from website only.
URL was flagged as 'uncertain' discovery confidence in OSM; confirmed correct via website content.
Contact page notes 'By appointment only' and 'if the gate is open come say Hi' suggesting access may not always be guaranteed outside tasting hours — worth flagging for cyclists planning a visit.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The winery is a genuine, actively operating destination on a popular Okanagan cycling route, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. A brief on-site or phone verification would resolve this quickly.
